description: Comment on a collection or artifact; the comment pins to its current revision/version. The response's `url` opens the comment - hand that to a person, not the id.

artifactId.description:
artifact_id comments on a single artifact (from get_artifact); use instead
 of collection_id.

body.description: body is the comment text (markdown welcome).

space.description:
space optionally selects which of your spaces to act in (an id or name
 from list_spaces). Omit it when you belong to a single space.

name: comment

url.description: url opens the comment where it sits - hand THAT to a person, never the bare id.

title: Comment
